inputs.text: [excited] Fifteen feet long — [amazed] as long as a big SUV. Standing up, six feet tall — [curious] as tall as Dad standing up. And one thousand one hundred kilos — [proud] as heavy as a small car. [calm] It walked calmly: 4 miles an hour, [pauses] like Dad walking fast.
[confident] Yep — [playful] but way more spiky than him.
